content:
harper: Heads-up: while auditing the dedicated capacity migration guide I found the autoscale example uses the old camelCase keys and a non-existent policy id. Will open a tiny migration PR.
james: Can you paste the snippet you saw? I can patch it quickly.
harper: Current snippet on page:```yaml
autoscale:
  policy:
    scaleUp:
      threshold: 0.9
      cooldown: 120
    policy_id: legacy-123
```
lina: Yep that's old. New schema uses snake_case and we prefer explicit min/max capacity for reserved pools. Proposed replacement:```yaml
autoscale:
  policy:
    scale_up:
      threshold: 0.85
      cooldown: 90
  min_capacity: 2
  max_capacity: 20
```
frank: Add a short sentence about what these numbers mean for reserved pools (min_capacity is warm GPUs; max_capacity caps burst). Also flag: legal wanted us to avoid tweaking SLA numbers.
legal-bot: Legal note: do not change SLA percentages. You may add clarifying parentheticals linking to /legal/sla-dedicated but leave numeric values untouched.
harper: Good call. I'll add the parenthetical link and not touch the SLA copy.
james: CI is currently failing on the docs build because the code fence language is `yml` in one file and our linter expects `yaml`. That caused the sample to not render.
ci-bot: docs build 1024 failed: lint -> code-fence-language (file: docs/dedicated/migration.md line 137)
lina: I'll fix the fence marker and run local lint. Also proposing we add a tiny `yq`-based smoke test in the docs CI to validate YAML samples so this doesn't regress.
harper: Also replace the CLI SDK ruby example with an up-to-date Python snippet and bump the SDK version in examples.
james: Example Python snippet (for provision) we can use:```python
import os
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
client.provision_tenant("team-x", labels=["team-x"])
```
frank: Please reference the SDK version in the snippet header: "python-sdk v1.2" and add a short note linking to the client docs.
harper: I'll open PR 5012 with: 1) replace camelCase autoscale example, 2) add min/max notes, 3) swap ruby example -> python v1.2, 4) fix fence markers, 5) add parenthetical SLA link, 6) tiny CI yaml linter test. Tagging @lina @james for review.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5012 by harper — 1 commit, 5 files changed
ci-bot: test pipeline queued for PR 5012 -> build 1030
lina: Quick review done; left a tiny wording suggestion about "reserved pools" -> "reserved capacity pools" for clarity.
james: LGTM for code changes. One nit: change max_capacity example to 16 to reflect common cluster sizes.
harper: Updated PR to max_capacity: 16 and fixed yq smoke test.
ci-bot: build 1030 -> passing (lint + smoke tests) :white_check_mark:
frank: Once merged, please backport the migration note to the v1.0 docs branch and add a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md.
harper: Will do backport after merge. Merging now.
docs-bot: PR 5012 merged into main and backport queued to v1.0 branch.
james: Verified staging render. All snippets show correct syntax highlighting and the Python example runs against a local mock.
harper: Closing thread. Thanks everyone.
